name: Piracetam
description: Small synthetic molecule (2-oxo-1-pyrrolidine acetamide), the first of the “racetams”; not a peptide

note.text: A maker-funded analysis found a global benefit; Cochrane (2001) and a 2024 review found no clear effect on memory or thinking.

bullets: **UK label:** its action in cortical myoclonus is unknown
**Label:** makes red cells more flexible and reduces platelet clumping
**In healthy volunteers,** high doses lowered fibrinogen and von Willebrand factor
**For memory in people,** the mechanism is not established
Many placebo-controlled trials in dementia, stroke
Approved in UK, Belgium, Luxembourg; not US

practical.halfLife: 5.0 hours in young adult men (UK label)
practical.routes: By mouth (tablets) on the UK label
practical.pharmacokinetics: Almost fully absorbed; no metabolite found; excreted in urine
practical.soldAs: Not FDA approved; FDA cited supplements containing it (2019)

regulatory.text: Not named; relative fonturacetam is S6.A

references: MHRA (emc), Nootropil 1200 mg UK SmPC, Jul 2025
FDA, bulk drug substances nominated under section 503B (categories), Mar 2025
